card.name: Words before a passive verb or 'should be'
card.fires_on: Small words right after 'should' or a drug-product noun in warning sentences, such as 'should be' or 'drug products', and a few other spots like 'Aaron and his sons' or Python 'obj.__setitem__'.

modes.label: Should be in warnings
modes.description: The word 'be' or 'have' after 'should' or 'can' in pregnancy or handling warnings.
modes.example: When pregnancy is detected, enalaprilat injection, USP should<< be>> discontinued as soon as possible.

modes.label: Drug product noun
modes.description: The word 'products' after 'Parenteral drug' before an instruction.
modes.example: NOTE: Parenteral drug<< products>> should be inspected visually for particulate matter

modes.label: Python dunder names
modes.description: Parts of double-underscore method names in code discussion.

card.writes: It lowers the chance of double-underscore code tokens and nudges toward ordinary continuing words.
card.plain: It fires on little connecting words in label warnings, like the 'be' in 'should be given'.
